sections.title: Modern web and app development

productHero.title: Product creative: photo, video and avatars
productHero.description: With the help of AI I can turn a single source photo into a full set of high-quality product images, videos and avatars. Ideal for e-shops that want to scale content without costly photo shoots.
productHero.subtitle: I focus on preserving product fidelity - colours, shapes, logos and copy stay consistent across all variants.
productHero.scalingNote: Maximise the potential of a single photo. From one source I create a full set of variants for your catalog or menu - the ideal way to quickly and affordably fill your e-shop or website with varied content.

productAvatars.title: Avatars and characters
productAvatars.description: With the help of AI I generate consistent avatars and characters for campaigns, social media and presentations. A unified look across visuals helps build a recognisable brand without a traditional photo session.

By integrating **AI** into the workflow I don't just deliver code but efficient solutions that save your time and budget. Looking for a partner who can see around the corner? You're in the right place.

list.what: Key contributor to rebuilding trezor.io completely from scratch on Next.js and GraphQL - close collaboration with product and design in an Agile/Scrum environment, translating Figma designs into high-performance UIs. Owned the development environment and Dockerization, was the primary technical expert for the Adyen payment gateway integration, took care of the testing environment (Playwright, unit/integration tests) and built internal tools to speed up deployments; also maintained the satoshilabs.com corporate website.

E-commerce, intranets and websites (Vue, React, PHP, PostgreSQL, AWS) - from a cryptocurrency exchange platform built with Web3, Ethereum and Solidity smart contracts for Flexiana, through an internal POS system for Alza (Angular, .NET), to independent projects like Světdovolené.cz, Actum, QEST and System Nine.
Built scalable JS/TS components and owned the frontend stack for a specialized analytics platform for Twitch streamers.
Frontend development (Angular, ReactJS, Node.js) of intranet applications and B2B portals for employees and clients, including complex backend customizations.
Frontend and backend systems (Phalcon, Angular, React, Redux, Webpack) for internal applications and B2B portals with complex backend work.
E-business and marketing processes in B2B.
